title: Larteh Akuapem - Wikipedia
text: Larteh is a twin town consisting of Larteh Kubease and Larteh Ahenease. The language spoken is Gua n which is a stock of the Kwa. The oral tradition of Larteh Kubease claims that they came from inland and settled west of the mouth of the Volta among the Kpesi, aborigines of Guan extraction.

text: Larteh, also known as Lɛtɛ or Leteh, is a South Guan language of the Kwa branch within the Niger-Congo family, spoken primarily in the town of Larteh in Ghana's Eastern Region.
